problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 6 delivery trucks to unload at 6 specialized docks.

Each truck has a predetermined sequence of docks it must visit, represented as (Dock, Unloading time) pairs, where each pair specifies the dock required and the time needed for unloading. The order of the pairs indicates the strict sequence the truck must follow.

Truck details:
* T1 must follow the sequence: (D5, 2) → (D6, 1) → (D1, 1) → (D2, 2) → (D4, 6) → (D3, 8)
* T2 must follow the sequence: (D3, 4) → (D1, 3) → (D4, 9) → (D2, 9) → (D6, 2) → (D5, 9)
* T3 must follow the sequence: (D2, 8) → (D1, 7) → (D6, 5) → (D3, 1) → (D4, 10) → (D5, 3)
* T4 must follow the sequence: (D4, 2) → (D2, 10) → (D6, 7) → (D3, 6) → (D1, 4) → (D5, 9)
* T5 must follow the sequence: (D4, 9) → (D1, 8) → (D6, 9) → (D3, 7) → (D5, 8) → (D2, 5)
* T6 must follow the sequence: (D2, 8) → (D6, 2) → (D3, 2) → (D1, 8) → (D5, 7) → (D4, 10)

Once a truck begins unloading at a dock, it must complete the entire unloading without interruption, and each dock can only accommodate one truck at a time. The objective is to determine the processing order of all trucks at the docks so that the total completion time for the entire fleet is minimized.
